business_summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (NSE: BPCL) is one of India's largest state-controlled oil refiners and marketers. It is expanding the Bina refinery from 7.8 MMTPA to 11 MMTPA with an attached petrochemical project, which reached financial closure in January 2025, the new Indian conversion capacity this chain's refinery-capacity-response link tracks.

exposure_summary.narrative: Bharat Petroleum sits on refinery-capacity-response (UNDISCOVERED, not the money corner), building the Bina refinery expansion cum petrochemical project (7.8 to 11 MMTPA) per its own January 2025 financial-closure press release. FY2026 statements (INR, year ended 2026-03-31) show roughly flat 3-year revenue (-1.2% CAGR), an 8.3% operating margin, strong operating cash conversion (2.0x OCF/NI) and a STRONG Piotroski read (7/9) with a CLEAN Beneish score.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No Bina-project-specific revenue percentage is sourced for Bharat Petroleum this run; the refinery expansion is one project within a much larger integrated refining and marketing revenue base.

latest_fy.basis: Vendor-normalized fiscal-year revenue (INR) for the period ended 2026-03-31, yfinance-statements aggregation of Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited's local financial statements (method section 6A vendor-aggregate fundamentals; INFERRED, official_source false, not a filing quote).

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (4503026700000.0 / 4662577300000.0) ** (1/3) - 1 from the yfinance-statements INR revenue series, period ended 2023-03-31 to period ended 2026-03-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 375681600000.0 (INR) divided by revenue 4503026700000.0 (INR), both for the period ended 2026-03-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 507689900000.0 divided by net income 258434500000.0, both INR for the period ended 2026-03-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 507689900000.0 less capex 194248200000.0, divided by revenue 4503026700000.0, all INR for the period ended 2026-03-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 541044300000.0 (total debt 544244200000.0 less cash 3199900000.0, both as of 2026-03-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 454245300000.0 (operating income 375681600000.0 plus depreciation 78563700000.0 for the period ended 2026-03-31), from the yfinance-statements series.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 7 (state STRONG) computed over yfinance-statements statements in data/market/BPCL-NS.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -3.495 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over yfinance-statements statements in data/market/BPCL-NS.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization computed in data/market/BPCL-NS.json quality.derived.market_cap from shares outstanding 4272584874.0 (as of 2026-03-31, source fundamentals.shares_fy) times the close 320.05 INR (as of 2026-09-03).

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 1367440788923.7 (INR) divided by fiscal year 2026-03-31 revenue 4503026700000.0 (INR).

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 1908485088923.7 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 313441700000.0, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over yfinance-statements statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': -0.1805, '7': -0.1383, '10': -0.1064}). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement.
